title: The moiré effect lights that guide ships home
summary: Tom Scott investigates moire-effect beacons, called Inogon leading marks, a Swedish invention from the 1980s that shows different patterns depending on the viewer's position. He visits one used to mark an undersea cable and tracks down its history.
why: Linked as the accessible explanation of how moire navigation lights work.
